concurrency: Single-threaded within the owning writer; duplicate detection and ordinal assignment are serialized.
dependencies: accepted xverse_xdl.experiment_plan public API/digest semantics (read-only, unchanged)
accepted C++ X-COM observation contract 1.0.0 (read-only, unchanged)
deployment: Offline, in-process Python library and console entry point inside the admitted ARGUS2 envelope: no process, service, container, network, device, provider handle, live tap, registry or oracle is created, started, probed or contacted.
rationale: Source allocation from docs/engineering/argus-lite/requirements.md ARGUS2-SR-003, realized by ARGUS2-ARCH-03/ARGUS2-ARCH-05 in docs/engineering/argus-lite/architecture.md section 4 and frozen in docs/engineering/argus-lite/detailed-design.md.
responsibilities: Freeze and enforce the versioned event record contract (schema version, run ID, unique event ID, producer ID, ingestion ordinal, kind).
Preserve optional producer sequence and optional correlation/causation references exactly.
Assign the local deterministic ingestion ordinal and never present it as temporal or causal order.
Reject an unknown event-schema major version, a duplicate event identity within one run, or a record missing a required identity field without retaining a partial accepted record.
Index causal references without inventing a missing predecessor.
state_ownership: Owns no durable state beyond the appended records; owns the in-memory duplicate-identity and causal-index sets bounded by the caller limits.
